assumptions.statement: AWS provides an Elasticache service with a Redis engine that supports clustered configurations.
assumptions.quote: AWS provide Elasticache which has a Redis engine, and can be configured to be clustered.

assumptions.statement: The client-side behavior of the Redis protocol remains unchanged when using Elasticache, preventing vendor lock-in.
assumptions.quote: There is no risk of lock-in because the client side behaviour is not changed.

assumptions.statement: The team currently manages Redis instances using Puppet code.
assumptions.quote: Traditionally we provisioned our own redis machines in a non-clustered state.
